Your holdings: SOXL (-48.92%) and SPAL (-39.96%) are leveraged, decaying, and deep in the red. SMH (-10.52%) is also down and flagged for trim. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the upcoming inflation data and how Treasury yields react. Also, watch for any follow-through on the AI concept endorsement.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers aggressively while staying alert to macro shifts that could hit your tech gains.
plays: SOXL is down almost 50% and leveraged. Consider adjusting its stop from 200 or trimming to reduce exposure to decay and amplified losses.
SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is down nearly 40%. Review its stop at 21.38 and consider trimming to manage risk from its fast moves and decay.
SMH is down over 10% and flagged for TRIM. Respect the 540 stop or consider trimming now to protect capital.
